title: Scholarship and Detention
author: A. M. Eriksen
blurb: Rafael Crane, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent seven years being so careful it hurts. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
